technical_checks.description: The target frame count, video-token layout, audio-token layout, and absolute origin match the checked plan.
The generated interval uses exact half-open token-aligned boundaries.
Known native state outside the denoise interval remains unchanged before decode.
Consumed denoise-mask metadata is cleared before persistence.
The run receipt resolves both the decoded artifact and retained native checkpoint.

visual_checks.description: No objectionable discontinuity, freeze, ghosting, or duplicated gesture at the left boundary.
No objectionable discontinuity, freeze, ghosting, or duplicated gesture at the right boundary.
The generated interval forms a coherent temporal passage between its known contexts.
Decoded content outside the requested interval remains acceptably stable.

technical_checks.description: The overlap and suffix use one globally aligned H3 AV timeline.
Only the explicit new suffix is appended to cumulative state.
The cumulative native result is content-addressed and retained.
The receipt binds source state, graph, runtime, prompt id, decoded artifact, and checkpoint.

visual_checks.description: Motion crosses the old/new boundary without a visible stall, reversal, duplicated beat, or jump.
Appearance drift remains acceptable for the requested continuation.
The new suffix adds usable temporal material rather than merely repeating the overlap.

technical_checks.description: Every source range is bound to an exact content hash.
The output frame count equals the sum of all declared half-open source ranges.
Output frames preserve the declared source and intra-source order.
The assembled artifact is resolved from the exact run history.

visual_checks.description: The decoded artifact contains the intended ranges in the intended order without accidental omissions.

technical_checks.description: Reference images and clips enter conditioning in the exact declared order.
Every reference clip uses an accepted 24 fps H3-valid length.
The graph selects the locked Ref2VA model and both required VAEs.
The receipt binds ordered input hashes and the saved output artifact.

visual_checks.description: The requested visible or temporal properties of the supplied references are present in the result.
The result is temporally coherent rather than a sequence of unstable reference reconstructions.
No unacceptable tiling, tearing, frozen region, or decode artifact is present.

technical_checks.description: Only the endpoint inputs declared by the selected variant are connected.
Resolution and target length match the checked H3 plan.
The graph selects the locked FL2VA model, text encoder, and video VAE.
The receipt binds exact parameters, runtime manifest, prompt id, and saved video artifact.

visual_checks.description: Supplied endpoints are reconstructed with acceptable fidelity at their declared temporal positions.
Motion between constrained and unconstrained frames is coherent.
A controlled prompt comparison demonstrates non-identical conditioning behavior at fixed seed.
No unacceptable tiling, tearing, frozen region, or decode artifact is present.

technical_checks.description: Every guide resolves to an exact valid target-frame position and accepted clip length.
All guides are chained on the active positive-conditioning edge.
Guide and target geometry follow the checked H3 lattice rules.
Ordered guide hashes, graph, parameters, and output artifact are retained.

visual_checks.description: The result reaches the supplied guide at the requested temporal position.
Motion approaching and leaving each guide remains coherent.
No unacceptable freeze, duplication, hard snap, or reconstruction scar surrounds a guide.

technical_checks.description: The cut lies on synchronized visual and structural-audio boundaries.
Re-appending the untouched suffix reconstructs the source native state exactly.
Prefix and reversible suffix are independently content-addressed.

visual_checks.description: The reconstructed state's decoded result is visually identical to the source within the chosen deterministic comparison.
